assert_is_instance_check_type: assert an object is an instance of a given class and raise TypeError if not
none_throws_validate_not_none: validate a value is not None and raise ValueError with an optional custom message if it is
test_assert_is_instance: test the assert_is_instance function to ensure it raises TypeError for mismatched types
test_none_throws: test the none_throws function to ensure it raises ValueError when passed None
review_typing_utilities: review the typing utility functions assert_is_instance and none_throws for correctness and edge cases
